# Newham Solutions Pte. Ltd.

> Newham works with construction businesses in Singapore and India in three ways: it builds the CCorex construction software suite, provides dedicated M&E engineering professionals (estimators, QS, BIM modellers, tender coordinators, fire protection engineers), and delivers scoped engineering services (fire protection design and hydraulic calculations, BOQ preparation and tender support).

## Services
- [BOQ preparation and M&E estimation services](https://newhamtech.com/boq-estimation-services): take-offs, priced BOQs, rate build-ups and tender queries for fire protection, ACMV, electrical, ELV and plumbing.
- [M&E engineering services](https://newhamtech.com/engineering-services): overview of Newham's fire protection design, estimation and BOQ, shop drawing and commercial support services.
- [Fire protection and sprinkler design](https://newhamtech.com/fire-protection-design): sprinkler design and hydraulic calculations to SS CP 52 (NFPA 13 where specified), fire alarm design to SS 645, formatted for SCDF submission.
- [ACMV and HVAC design](https://newhamtech.com/acmv-design-services): heat load calculations, equipment selection, ductwork and chilled water piping, mechanical ventilation, to SS 553 / SS 554.
- [Electrical design](https://newhamtech.com/electrical-design-services): load schedules, single-line diagrams, cable sizing, lighting, small power and containment, to SS 638.
- [Plumbing and sanitary design](https://newhamtech.com/plumbing-sanitary-design-services): water supply, sanitary plumbing and drainage, to SS 636 and PUB codes of practice.
- [ELV design](https://newhamtech.com/elv-design-services): CCTV, access control, structured cabling, PA, MATV and car park systems; telecom facilities to IMDA COPIF.
- [MEP shop drawing and as-built drafting](https://newhamtech.com/shop-drawing-services): MEP shop drawings, coordination drawings and as-built drawings.
- [Engineering talent outsourcing](https://newhamtech.com/talent-outsourcing): dedicated M&E estimators, QS, BIM modellers and coordinators working in the client's templates.
- [CCorex software](https://ccorex.com): estimating, project cost control and HR & payroll for contractors.

## Guides
- [MEP shop drawings in Singapore](https://newhamtech.com/guides/mep-shop-drawings-singapore): what MEP shop drawings contain, coordination and combined services drawings, Revit vs AutoCAD, and the review cycle.
- [Sprinkler hazard classification in Singapore](https://newhamtech.com/guides/sprinkler-hazard-classification-singapore): how SS CP 52 hazard classes work, SCDF Fire Code 2023 sprinkler triggers and Ordinary Hazard water demand.
- [Wet and dry riser requirements in Singapore](https://newhamtech.com/guides/wet-and-dry-riser-requirements-singapore): SCDF Fire Code 2023 rising main rules, landing valve coverage, breeching inlets, flow and pressure.
- [Fire hose reel requirements in Singapore](https://newhamtech.com/guides/fire-hose-reel-requirements-singapore): coverage, siting, hose size, flow and pressure, pumps, tanks and testing under the SCDF Fire Code 2023.
- [Fire protection tender estimation in Singapore](https://newhamtech.com/guides/fire-protection-tender-estimation-singapore): system-by-system BOQ sections, pricing steps and common misses on FP tenders.
- [All guides](https://newhamtech.com/guides)
